title: Simplification and Approximation: Fast, Safe Arithmetic

questions.question: Evaluate: 12 / 3 x 2 + 5 - sqrt(16).
questions.rationale: BODMAS with left-to-right for division/multiplication: 12/3 = 4, 4 x 2 = 8, sqrt(16) = 4. Then 8 + 5 - 4 = 9. Doing multiplication before division would wrongly give 12/(3x2) = 2.

questions.question: Simplify: [8 - {5 - (7 - 3)}].
questions.rationale: Clear brackets from the inside out: (7 - 3) = 4, then {5 - 4} = 1, then [8 - 1] = 7.

questions.question: The value of 10 - 4 + 3 is:
questions.rationale: Addition and subtraction share a rank and run left to right: 10 - 4 = 6, then 6 + 3 = 9. Doing 4 + 3 first (wrongly) gives 10 - 7 = 3.

questions.question: 63.98% of 449.9 + ? is approximately 480. The missing number is closest to:
questions.rationale: Approximate 64% of 450 = 0.64 x 450 = 288. Then 480 - 288 = 192. The options are spaced widely apart, so rounding 63.98 to 64 and 449.9 to 450 is safe.

questions.question: 37.5% of 256 equals:
questions.rationale: 37.5% = 3/8, so the value is (3/8) x 256 = 3 x 32 = 96. Knowing the fraction equivalents turns a long multiplication into a two-second calculation.

questions.question: 97 x 103 equals:
questions.rationale: The factors sit symmetrically about 100: 97 x 103 = (100 - 3)(100 + 3) = 100^2 - 9 = 9991. Difference-of-squares beats multiplication.

questions.question: The value of (3/4) of 240 - 15% of 200 + sqrt(225) is:
questions.rationale: Convert 'of' to multiplication: (3/4) x 240 = 180; 15% of 200 = 30; sqrt(225) = 15. Then 180 - 30 + 15 = 165.

questions.question: 36 / (3/4 of 16) equals:
questions.rationale: 'Of' is evaluated first: (3/4) x 16 = 12. Then 36 / 12 = 3. Misreading 'of' as a plain division produces the distractor 48.

questions.question: The square of 45 is best found instantly as:
questions.rationale: For numbers ending in 5: take n = 4, compute n(n + 1) = 20 and append 25, giving 2025. The identity (10n + 5)^2 = 100n(n + 1) + 25 makes every such square instant.

questions.question: sqrt(1369) + sqrt(2025) - 34 / 17 equals:
questions.rationale: Recognise the squares: 37^2 = 1369 and 45^2 = 2025. Division first: 34/17 = 2. So 37 + 45 - 2 = 80. Memorising squares to 30 (and beyond) is what makes this a 10-second question.
